The build passes. Here's a summary of the change.

## Summary

Changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (global sequence) to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (per-city sequence).

**`CustomerCodeGenerator`** — the formatting unit:
- `generate(city, lastName, sequence)` now emits `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.
- Extracted a small private `prefix(value)` helper (upper-case, first three chars) so the city and last-name prefixes are derived by one shared rule instead of duplicated logic.

**`ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner`** — the wiring:
- The sequence is now *per-city*: `countOwnersInCity(owner.getCity()) + 1`, matching "one more than the owners already in that city."
- Added a focused `countOwnersInCity(city)` helper (case-insensitive), mirroring the existing `countNamesakes` style and reusing the existing `equalsIgnoreCase` helper.

**`MembershipNumberGenerator`** — no change needed: it already builds the membership number from `owner.getCustomerCode()`, so it's automatically rebuilt on the new format. That's the only value derived from the customer code.

The new acceptance test (`coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, asserting the `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}` shape) and the full suite pass (BUILD SUCCESS).

**`ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner`** — the wiring:

**`MembershipNumberGenerator`** — no change needed: it already builds the membership number from `owner.getCustomerCode()`, so it's automatically rebuilt on the new format. That's the only value derived from the customer code.
